title: Shower Door Handle Pull, 9-Inch, Solid Brass & Acrylic Accents - Clearview Collection, Allied Brass
body_html:
Open and close your glass shower door with a secure grip and a crisp, minimalist look that suits modern bathroom hardware.

  • Confident handling: U-shaped pull crafted from solid brass for a substantial, reliable feel.
  • Clean, modern design: Acrylic accents add a light, architectural touch inspired by the Clearview collection.
  • Finished appearance: Concealed screw mounting hardware keeps the installation looking clean.
  • Easy to install: Includes installation hardware and instructions for shower door mounting.
  • Coordinate your space: Designed to pair with contemporary bath accessories and minimalist bathroom fixtures.

Specs & Details

  • Product type: Single side shower door pull / shower door handle
  • Material: Brass with acrylic accents
  • Mounting type: Shower door mount (concealed screw mounting)
  • Dimensions (L x H x W): 9 x 3.9 x 1.7 inches
  • Product weight: 3.2 lb
  • Included: Shower door pull and all installation hardware
  • Warranty: Limited lifetime warranty
